html:
Buy Gemstone Price Calculator

Yes, this is the free tool you need to estimate how much a gemstone will cost you. Enter the stone’s type, carat weight and other details, and CaratBase instantly shows a market‑based price range.

How it works for a single gemstone purchase

  1. Open the Gemstone Calculator page.
  2. Choose the gem type from the 21 options (e.g., sapphire, emerald).
  3. Enter the carat weight and any clarity or color grades you have.
  4. Click Calculate to see the estimated price based on current market data.

What you get and the cost

  • The calculator is completely free; no account or payment is required.
  • Results are based on CaratBase’s price model, not a licensed appraisal.
  • You can save the calculation locally with My Vault for later reference.

FAQ

How accurate is the price estimate? The estimate reflects current market trends for natural and lab‑grown stones, using a model that tracks resale percentages (natural 25‑40 %, lab‑grown 5‑12 %). It is not a formal appraisal.

Can I use the calculator on my own website? Yes. CaratBase offers free widgets (e.g., gemstone calculator) that you can embed with a “Powered by CaratBase” line. For a widget without attribution, the Widget Pro plan is $12 /month per domain.

Do I need to create an account to keep my results? No. You can store calculations on your device via My Vault without signing up.

Start calculating your gemstone price now
